name: Vermont

windshield.strip: no material painted or adhered on the windshield except small permitted spaces (4 x 12 in. lower right corner, 2 x 2.5 in. upper left corner, stickers required by regulation); no tint strip allowance in statute

frontSide.note: No material may be painted or adhered on the side windows immediately left and right of the operator (aftermarket tint prohibited; medical exemption possible)

backSide.note: rear side windows may be obstructed only if a securely attached mirror is fitted on each side

rear.note: back window may be obstructed only with mirrors on each side

tint.measuredHow: not stated (no numeric VLT in statute)
tint.dualMirrors: Securely attached mirror on each side required if the rear side windows or back window are obstructed

medicalExemption.text: DMV Commissioner exemption on application with a document signed by a licensed physician or optometrist certifying medical necessity; renewed every 4 years (unless certified permanent and stable); limited to the vent windows and front side windows; ends on vehicle transfer (seller must remove the tint)

penalty.text: Not stated in § 1125 (general traffic violation civil penalty)

quotes: a person shall not operate a motor vehicle on which material or items have been painted or adhered on or over, or hung in back of, any transparent part of a motor vehicle windshield, vent windows, or side windows located immediately to the left and right of the operator
the window shading or tinting permitted under this subsection shall be limited to the vent windows or side windows located immediately to the left and right of the operator
The rear side windows and the back window may be obstructed only if the motor vehicle is equipped on each side with a securely attached mirror

helmet.conditions: All operators and riders (fully enclosed autocycles excepted)

handheldPhone.noviceOrAgeBan: Under 18: no use of any portable electronic device, even hands-free (23 V.S.A. § 1095a)
handheldPhone.fineText: $100-$200 first violation, $250-$500 second within 2 years; $200-$400 / $500-$1,000 plus points in work or school zones

radarDetector.note: No state ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

openQuestions: Vermont DMV inspection manual (which may tolerate some front-side tint) not read; statute alone bans adhered material on front side windows
Studded tire rule not located in 23 V.S.A. (believed unrestricted, not confirmed)
Underglow and lift rules not located
